description:
The Software Engineer is a position within Dematic’s Lifecycle Solutions & Services Software Engineering organization responsible for executing defined software engineering assignments as part of customer project teams.

The role contributes to the delivery of reliable, high-quality software solutions for automated warehouse systems through software development, implementation, integration, testing, troubleshooting, and support.

The position applies technical and domain knowledge to independently complete assigned work, take ownership of defined software deliverables, and resolve common technical issues.

The role contributes to successful project execution and customer value while providing opportunities for continued growth within the Software Engineering career path through expanded technical knowledge, solution ownership, project responsibility, and customer engagement.

The base pay range for this role is estimated to be $ 76,500 - 105,000 at the time of posting. Final compensation will be determined by various factors such as work location, education, experience, knowledge, and skills.

Join our team and play a key role in developing innovative software solutions that transform automation in the material handling industry! 
 We offer: 
 Core Responsibilities: 
 Design, develop, and maintain software applications for material handling systems.
 Collaborate with product managers, engineers, and stakeholders to define technical requirements and solutions.
 Implement scalable and efficient software solutions, ensuring reliability and performance.
 Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize software applications for industrial automation.
 Write well-structured, maintainable, and testable code following best practices.
 Conduct unit and integration testing to validate software functionality.
 Contribute to software documentation, including user manuals, technical specifications, and change logs.
 Support software integration with hardware components, including warehouse automation systems.
 Conduct unit and integration testing to ensure software reliability and functionality.
 Required Qualifications: 
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
 2 - 5+ years of professional software development experience.
 Proficiency in programming languages such as C, C++, C#.
 Strong understanding of software development methodologies (Agile, Scrum, or Waterfall).
 Experience with version control systems such as Azure TFS or Git.
 Knowledge of RESTful API development and microservices architecture.
 Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with attention to detail.
 Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
 Preferred Qualifications: 
 Experience working in industrial automation, supply chain, or material handling industries.
 Hands-on experience with warehouse software, including WMS, WES, or WCS.
 Familiarity with real-time software systems and embedded development.
 Experience with frontend frameworks.
 Exposure to enterprise software development and system integrations.
 
 Tasks and Qualifications: 
 Desired Strengths: 
 Technical Expertise: Ability to design and implement efficient and scalable software solutions.
 Results-Oriented: Ability to work independently and drive projects to completion on time.
 Collaboration & Communication: Strong teamwork skills with the ability to work cross-functionally.
 Accountability: Takes ownership of work, ensuring high-quality outcomes.
 Adaptability: Willingness to learn new technologies and pivot as business needs evolve.
 Customer-Centric Approach: Understands how software solutions impact end users and ensures alignment with business objectives.
 Additional Details: 
 This is a full-time position with opportunities for professional growth and career advancement.
 Some travel may be required depending on project needs.
 Competitive salary and benefits package provided.
